entry.content:
Privacy Policy for Save Jeny

Introduction

Welcome to Save Jeny! We are committed to protecting your privacy. Because Save Jeny is a fully offline game, your data remains entirely in your hands. This Privacy Policy explains how your information is handled.

No Online Accounts Required

Save Jeny does not require you to create an account, sign in, or provide any personal information to play. You can enjoy the full game completely offline.

Local Data Storage and Usage

The game saves your progress, high scores, and settings solely on your local device. No online cloud saves are used, and no data is transmitted over the internet.

Data Security and Responsibility

Because your save files are stored locally on your device, they are as secure as your phone or tablet itself. Please note that we do not have access to your device; if your device is lost, stolen, damaged, or cleared, we cannot recover your game progress for you.

Third-Party Access and Developer Access

We do not collect, track, sell, share, or distribute any of your data. As developers, we have zero access to your device's save files or gameplay history. Your data belongs entirely to you.

Third-Party Platform Collection

While the game itself functions entirely offline, please be aware that the store platforms you use to download or purchase the game (such as Google Play or itch.io) may automatically collect certain device data, distribution statistics, or payment information in accordance with their own respective privacy policies. We do not control and are not responsible for the data practices of these individual storefronts.

Enjoy Save Jeny

We hope you enjoy playing Save Jeny with peace of mind, knowing that your gaming experience is 100% private and secure.

Contact Us

If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please feel free to Contact Us.

Privacy Policy for The Cube

Introduction

Welcome to The Cube! We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring that your data remains secure. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information.

Data Collection and Usage

The Cube records user data solely on your device. This data is only accessible to you and is not stored on our servers.

Data Security

We have implemented robust security measures to ensure that your data is protected and remains private. The data you record on your phone will only be shown to you and will not be accessible to us, the developers.

If your device gets hacked or stolen, we cannot take responsibility for recovering or securing your data.

Third-Party Access

We do not sell, share, or distribute your data to any third parties. Your data is yours alone, and we respect your privacy.

Developer Access

As developers, we do not have access to the data you record on your device. All data is securely stored on your phone and is only accessible to you.

Third-Party Platform Collection

While the game itself functions entirely offline, please be aware that the store platforms you use to download or purchase the game (such as Google Play or itch.io) may automatically collect certain device data, distribution statistics, or payment information in accordance with their own respective privacy policies. We do not control and are not responsible for the data practices of these individual storefronts.

Enjoy The Cube

We hope you enjoy using The Cube and feel confident knowing that your data is secure and private.

entry.title: privacy-policy
entry.content:
Privacy Policy for Ftake

1. Data Collection & Usage

  • We do not store any user data on our servers.
  • All user data is saved locally on the user’s device.
  • We do not have access to, sell, or share user data.
  • User data is used solely for the purpose of running the game; it is not used beyond this scope.

2. Advertisements & Rewards

  • Ftake displays advertisements through AdMob to allow users to earn in-game rewards.

  • Ads are provided by third-party services, including Google AdMob. You can review AdMob’s policies here:AdMob Terms & Conditions

  • Users may remove ads through a one-time purchase in the Play Store.

3. In-Game Currency

  • Ftake uses Banana Points, a virtual currency that cannot be converted to real money.
  • Users can earn Banana Points by watching advertisements.
  • The game does not involve real-money transactions for gameplay.

4. Addiction Disclaimer

  • Ftake is a free-to-play game that includes ads and rewards.
  • We are not responsible for any form of addiction or excessive gameplay by users.

5. Acceptance of Policy

By playing Ftake, users accept this Privacy Policy and its terms. Continued use of the game indicates agreement with these practices.

Third-Party Platform Collection

While the game itself functions entirely offline, please be aware that the store platforms you use to download or purchase the game (such as Google Play or itch.io) may automatically collect certain device data, distribution statistics, or payment information in accordance with their own respective privacy policies. We do not control and are not responsible for the data practices of these individual storefronts.

Contact Us

If you have any questions or concerns about our Privacy Policy, please feel free to Contact Us.
